summary.description: Two to four sentences: what the change does and its overall quality. No findings here.

findings.description: Correctness and simplification findings, most severe first. Empty when there are none.

severity.description: high = wrong results or data loss in normal use; medium = wrong in an edge case, or a real maintenance trap; low = a simplification or a minor risk.

kind.description: correctness = the code misbehaves; simplification = the code works but could be simpler.

file.description: The file, relative to the repository root, or 'input' for code given in the input.

location.description: A line range when known, otherwise an anchor such as 'the new retry loop'.

claim.description: What is wrong, grounded in the code read.

suggested_fix.description: A specific change the author could make.

confidence.description: high = verified from code read; medium = strong inference; low = depends on code not seen.

verdict.description: approve = nothing to address; approve_with_suggestions = only low or medium findings; changes_requested = at least one high finding.

human_summary.description: Written LAST. The review comment for the author in Markdown: the verdict in plain words, then the findings that matter most and what to do about each.
